claims.text: 300 method: count the lrg boxes b/n two R waves and divide 300 by that # (memorize 300, 150, 100, 75, 60, 50, 43, 37)
claims.quote: 300 method: Count large boxes between two R waves; divide 300 by that number. Memorize: 300, 150, 100, 75, 60, 50, 43, 37.

claims.text: 1500 method: count the sm boxes b/n R waves and divide 1500 by that # — the most precise for regular rhythms
claims.quote: 1500 method: Count small boxes between R waves; divide 1500 by that number. Most precise for regular rhythms.

claims.text: 6-second method: count the QRS complexes in 30 lrg boxes (6 seconds) and multiply by 10 — best for irreg rhythms
claims.quote: 6-second method: Count QRS complexes in 30 large boxes (6 sec) and multiply by 10. Best for irregular rhythms.

claims.text: What the rate means Brady: < 60 bpm
